method: Derived from final raw runs. Native paced input and 120 RAF-paced DOM moves during a native held navigation gesture are distinct. Captured monitor intervals include release/coherent-tail/refinement where present. Host stage vectors are bounded rings; initial upload is taken from the pre-navigation snapshot. No GPU-completion/photon or numerical-brush speedup claim.
